rationale: Layered translucent surfaces separate risk signals from background data without adding hard borders.
A cool, low-saturation palette keeps red and amber severity badges the highest-contrast elements on screen.
Depth cues map naturally onto a drill-down flow from portfolio to individual account.

brief.audience: B2B revenue and risk operations analysts monitoring account health across a large customer portfolio.
brief.primaryGoal: Surface accounts whose risk score moved materially this week and let an analyst triage them without leaving the dashboard.
brief.notes: Severity colour must stay legible against translucent panels; verify contrast on both light and dark backdrops.

constraints: Risk severity must never be encoded by colour alone.
Primary table has to stay readable at 1280px width.
No blocking full-screen loaders on the overview route.
